title: Fault-tolerant $|\sqrt{ \mathrm{T} }\rangle$ state preparation and injection for more efficient fine-grained quantum circuit synthesis
summary: Magic-state injection is a standard route to realize universal fault-tolerant quantum computation. Whereas the set of Clifford gates in combination with the non-Clifford T gate is a widely used universal gate set, extending the available set of non-Clifford primitives can reduce compilation overhead, provided that the additional primitives can be prepared fault-tolerantly with competitive resource costs and at sufficiently low logical noise rates. In this work, we introduce flag fault-tolerant protocols for preparing logical $|\sqrt{\mathrm{T}} \rangle $ magic states on the 3D tetrahedral…
